beats.say: L N Y against X is a line through two, three and four, seven. Y is A E to the power minus N X.
X sits in the power, so take L N of both sides. Add Power splits the right side.
L N E is one, so the power comes down. L N Y equals minus N X plus L N A.
This is Y equals M X plus C. The gradient is minus N, and the intercept is L N A.
Gradient from the two points: seven minus three over four minus two is two.
Substitute two, three to find C. Three equals two times two plus C, so C is minus one.
The gradient is minus N, not N. Minus N is two, so N is minus two.
Un-log the intercept. L N A is minus one, so A is E to the power minus one.
N equals minus two. A equals E to the power minus one, about zero point three six eight.
